description: Here we created STELLAR, a geometric deep learning approach for the discovery and identification of cell types in spatially resolved single-cell datasets. STELLAR automatically assigns cells to known cell types based on an annotated reference dataset and uncovers novel cell types and states. Moreover, STELLAR can transfer annotations across diverse dissection regions, tissues, and donors, while capturing higher-order tissue structures through learned cell representations. We successfully applied STELLAR to CODEX multiplexed fluorescent microscopy data and multiplexed RNA imaging datasets. This could be leveraged within other large atlasing efforts.
